articles.title: Sensex Jumps 905 Points, Nifty Closes Above 22,900
articles.description: Indian benchmark indices ended Thursday's session with strong gains, recovering from the previous day's decline. The BSE Sensex jumped 905.01 points, or 1.24%, to close at 74,151.04, while the Nifty 50 rose 237.90 points, or 1.05%, to settle at 22,936.75. Buying across major sectors lifted sentiment, with the Nifty Realty index leading the rally. The US Federal Reserve's decision to hold interest rates unchanged also remained in focus. Realty and FMCG Lead Sectoral Gains The Nifty Realty index emerged as the top-performing sector, rising 2.75%, followed by the Nifty FMCG index, which gained 2.34%. Banking stocks also witnessed buying interest, with Kotak Mahindra Bank advancing 4.32%. IT stocks recovered from Wednesday's losses, while the Nifty Auto index was the only sectoral loser, declining 0.24%. The broader market participated in the rally, with the mid-cap and small-cap indices gaining approximately 0.99% and 0.95%, respectively. Federal Reserve Holds Rates; Crude Oil Above $114 The US Federal Reserve maintained its benchmark interest rate at 3.75% to 4%, keeping investors focused on its outlook for inflation and future monetary policy. Meanwhile, Brent crude prices declined approximately 1.4% to around $114 per barrel. Despite the decline, elevated oil prices continued to pose inflation and import-cost risks for India. Nifty 50: Key Index Contributors Kotak Mahindra Bank contributed the most to the Nifty's gains, adding 30.64 points. Adani Ports and Eternal followed with contributions of 18.94 and 18.84 points, respectively. On the downside, HDFC Bank dragged the index by 6.71 points, followed by Maruti Suzuki at 4.36 points and Trent at 3.81 points. Market Breadth Remains Positive Market breadth favoured buyers, with 2,196 stocks advancing against 1,387 declines among 3,693 traded stocks. Another 110 stocks remained unchanged. During the session, 54 stocks touched their 52-week highs, while 117 slipped to 52-week lows. Additionally, 140 stocks hit upper circuits compared with 69 stocks hitting lower circuits. European Markets Trade Higher European equities traded higher on Thursday, led by France's CAC 40, which gained 0.97% to 7,963.48. Germany's DAX rose 0.90% to 25,936.06, while the UK's FTSE 100 advanced 0.32% to 10,728.70. All three indices remained in positive territory as European trading continued. US Stock Futures Show Mixed Trend US stock index futures traded mixed, with Dow Jones futures rising 304 points, or 0.58%, to 53,000. In contrast, S&P 500 futures declined 15 points, or 0.19%, to 7,768.25, while Nasdaq 100 futures dropped 276.50 points, or 0.92%, to 29,703, indicating weakness in technology-heavy futures.

articles.title: Miata Intersects 13.59 m at 10.33 g/t Au, Including 3.56 m at 37.62 g/t Au, at Jons Trend, Sela Creek, Suriname
articles.description: VANCOUVER, British Columbia, Oct. 29, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Miata Metals Corp. (TSXV: MMET; FSE: 8NQ; OTCQX: MMETF) ("Miata” or the "Company”) is pleased to announce drill results from four holes from its ongoing 25,000 m diamond drilling program at its Sela Creek Gold Project ("Sela Creek” or the "Project”) in Suriname. Hole 26DDH-JT-026 delivered an exceptionally high-grade intercept of 13.59 m at 10.33 g/t Au from 184.41 m, including 3.56 m at 37.62 g/t Au. This result represents a step-out from recently reported hole 26DDH-JT-025, which intersected 43.0 m at 2.42 g/t Au and a separate 25.6 m at 1.96 g/t Au, further supporting the continuity of mineralization through central Jons Trend. JT-026 also intersected a separate 21.0 m at 1.01 g/t Au from 207.0 m, including 6.95 m at 1.45 g/t Au, providing further evidence for multiple stacked mineralized zones at Jons Trend. Highlights: Hole 26DDH-JT-026 intersected: 13.59 m at 10.33 g/t Au from 184.41 m, including: 3.56 m at 37.62 g/t Au from 184.41 m21.0 m at 1.01 g/t Au from 207.0 m, including: 6.95 m at 1.45 g/t Au from 219.0 mAdditional mineralization includes 4.52 m at 1.14 g/t Au from 132.48 m and 1.0 m at 3.53 g/t Au from 238.0 m. Hole 26DDH-JT-026 represents a step-out from recently reported hole JT-025, further demonstrating the continuity of mineralization through the central portion of Jons Trend. The additional 21.0 m mineralized interval below the headline intersect further demonstrates the stacked nature of the gold-bearing vein system at Jons Trend. "JT-026 is another exceptional result from central Jons Trend and, importantly, provides further evidence for continuity of the higher-grade mineralization at depth,” stated Dr. Jacob (Jaap) Verbaas, CEO of Miata Metals. "The interval of 13.59 m at 10.33 g/t Au, including 3.56 metres at 37.62 grams per tonne gold, is one of Miata’s highest-grade intervals reported to date. The additional 21-metre mineralized interval below the headline zone also reinforces the stacked nature of the system. Together with the two broad intervals recently reported from JT-025, we continue to see an encouraging combination of grade, width and continuity through the central portion of Jons Trend. Our ongoing drilling is focused on extending these mineralized zones along their interpreted plunge and at depth.” Figure 1. SW-NE cross-section through central Jons Trend showing 26DDH-JT-026 and nearby drilling. Highlight intervals in JT-026 include 13.59 m at 10.33 g/t Au, including 3.56 m at 37.62 g/t Au, and a separate 21.0 m at 1.01 g/t Au. Jons Trend Drilling: Hole 26DDH-JT-026 was collared on the southwest side of central Jons Trend and drilled toward the north-northeast to test the continuation of the mineralized vein system at depth. The hole represents a step-out from recently reported JT-025, further supporting the continuity of mineralization through central Jons Trend. The principal interval in JT-026 returned 13.59 m at 10.33 g/t Au from 184.41 m, including 3.56 m at 37.62 g/t Au from 184.41 m. The results from JT-026 build on the recently reported intersections in JT-025, providing further evidence of continuity within the mineralized system at central Jons Trend. The high-grade interval in JT-026 also demonstrates the presence of higher-grade mineralization within the broader stacked vein system. Mineralization within the JT-026 high-grade interval is associated with strong silicification and a silica-sulfide breccia within the southwest-dipping vein array. Visible gold has also been observed within the mineralized interval. Figure 2. Core photographs from the JT-026 high-grade interval showing silica-sulfide brecciation, quartz veining and visible gold. A. 26DDH-JT-026 at 185.27 m (6.36 g/t Au) showing quartz-pyrite (py)-chlorite vein cross-cutting silica and biotite altered schist. B. 26DDH-JT-026 at 185.69 m (4.56 g/t Au) showing quartz-pyrite extensional veining and brecciation, with thin fractures filled with visible gold (Au) cross-cutting veins. Below the headline intersection, JT-026 returned a separate interval of 21.0 m at 1.01 g/t Au from 207.0 m, including 6.95 m at 1.45 g/t Au from 219.0 m. The presence of multiple mineralized intervals at different depths is consistent with the stacked-vein architecture observed throughout central Jons Trend. The results from JT-026 further extend the mineralization identified in recently reported hole JT-025, which returned two broad zones of 25.6 m at 1.96 g/t Au and 43.0 m at 2.42 g/t Au. Collectively, the drilling continues to demonstrate the continuity of broad mineralized zones through central Jons Trend, with higher-grade mineralization occurring within the broader stacked vein system. Figure 3. Plan view of Jons Trend highlighting JT-026 through JT-030 and the location of previously reported hole JT-025, an interpreted E-W-trending structural boundary northwest of Jons Trend, and the principal interpreted footprint of mineralized vein zones. Western and Northwestern Step-Out Drilling at Jons Trend: Holes 26DDH-JT-027 through to JT-030 tested the western and northwestern extent of Jons Trend and the continuation of mineralization across an interpreted E-W-trending structural zone northwest of the Jons Pit discovery area. JT-027 intersected several mineralized intervals, including 3.60 m at 2.63 g/t Au, 6.82 m at 1.05 g/t Au and 15.62 m at 0.65 g/t Au. The more distal holes JT-028 through JT-030 returned only narrow mineralized intervals. The results provide additional definition of the western and northwestern boundary of the principal Jons Trend mineralized system. The Company’s ongoing drilling is focused on the central mineralized axis and its down-dip and down-plunge extensions, where broad and higher-grade mineralization remains open, and identifying extensions on the southeastern end. articles.title: Mike Alfred joins Opendoor Board of Directors
articles.description: SAN FRANCISCO, Oct. 29, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Opendoor Technologies Inc. ("Opendoor”) (Nasdaq: OPEN), the e-commerce platform for residential real estate, today announced that Mike Alfred, Founder and Managing Partner of Alpine Fox LP, has been appointed to its Board of Directors ("Board”), effective immediately. Mr. Alfred will also serve on the Nominating and Corporate Governance Committee of the Board. "I’m excited to welcome Mike to our Board,” said Kaz Nejatian, Opendoor CEO, President and Board Director. "Mike is a builder who has founded and scaled technology companies, and he’s spent years as an investor thinking about how companies create long-term value. His perspective as an operator, investor and public company director will be incredibly valuable as we continue to make buying and selling a home simple and certain.” "I’m honored to join Opendoor’s Board,” said Mr. Alfred. "Opendoor is tackling one of the largest and most important markets in the world. I look forward to working with Kaz, the Board and the management team to help build on the company’s momentum.” Mr. Alfred is the Founder and Managing Partner of Alpine Fox LP, a private investment partnership and a shareholder of Opendoor. He has served on the board of directors of IREN Limited (Nasdaq: IREN), an AI data center developer and Bitcoin miner, since 2021, and of Bakkt Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: BKKT) since 2025. Previously, Mr. Alfred co-founded and served as Chief Executive Officer of Digital Assets Data, Inc., a financial technology and data company serving the digital asset ecosystem, until its sale to New York Digital Investment Group in 2020. Before that, he co-founded and served as Chief Executive Officer of BrightScope, Inc., a financial information company, from 2008 until its acquisition by Strategic Insight, Inc. in 2016. He then served as a Managing Director and member of Strategic Insight’s executive committee. Mr. Alfred also advises the Chief Executive Officer of Amenify Corporation, a real estate technology company, and serves on the boards of the privately held companies Eaglebrook Advisors and Wealthie Inc. He holds a B.A. in History from Stanford University. About Opendoor Opendoor exists to tilt the world in favor of homeowners by making homeownership simpler, faster, and fairer for everyone. Since 2014, Opendoor has given people a more convenient, more certain way to buy and sell a home, whether they already own or are working hard to become homeowners. Opendoor currently operates in markets across the U.S. For more information, please visit www.opendoor.com. Contacts Investors: investors@opendoor.com Media: Contact Kaz on X @Nejatian

articles.title: Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results
articles.description: MIAMI, Oct. 29, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings Ltd. (NYSE: NCLH) (together with NCL Corporation Ltd. ("NCLC”), "Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings”, "Norwegian”, "NCLH” or the "Company”) today reported financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026 and provided guidance for the fourth quarter and full year 2026. Highlights Third quarter total revenue was $2.9 billion. GAAP net income was $491 million with EPS of $1.07. Delivered third quarter results above guidance, with Adjusted EBITDA1 of $937 million, Adjusted Net Income of $514 million and Adjusted EPS of $1.12. Raised full year 2026 guidance, with 2026 Adjusted EBITDA now expected to be approximately $2.55 billion and Adjusted EPS of approximately $1.70. Opened Great Tides Waterpark in early September at the Company’s private island, Great Stirrup Cay. Spanning nearly six acres, the waterpark expands the island’s offerings with attractions for guests of all ages. Announced additional run-rate savings of ~$100 million related to guest and crew air optimization and other tactical changes in promotional offerings that will phase in through 2028. Completed the issuance of $950 million of senior notes due 2031 on October 15, which together with the upsizing of the Revolving Loan Facility, enhanced the Company’s liquidity position. Completed the sale of Oceania Sirena and entered into a charter agreement to continue operating the vessel through spring 2028. Entered into a memorandum of agreement to sell Oceania Insignia with an expected delivery to the buyer in September 2027. "We delivered third quarter results that came in above guidance, all while continuing to strengthen our commercial capabilities, improve operating efficiency and enhance the guest experience,” said John W. Chidsey, Chairperson and Chief Executive Officer of Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings Ltd. "As we implement the next phase of our turnaround, we are focused on sharpening Norwegian Cruise Line’s brand positioning, improving marketing effectiveness and taking a more disciplined approach to revenue management as well as a prudent base-loading strategy. We are seeing the early signs of progress and expect Net Yield growth of 1% to 2% in 2027, with a meaningful acceleration in the back half of the year.” ____________________ 1 See "Terminology”, "Non-GAAP Financial Measures” and "Outlook and Guidance” below for additional information about Adjusted EPS, Adjusted EBITDA, Adjusted Net Income, Net Leverage and other non-GAAP financial measures. Third Quarter 2026 Highlights The Company delivered third quarter results above guidance, driven primarily by stronger-than-expected close-in demand and onboard spend. Continued cost discipline also contributed to lower-than-expected unit costs, further supporting the quarter’s profitability. Generated total revenue of $2.9 billion. GAAP net income was $491 million compared to $419 million in the prior year, with EPS of $1.07. Gross margin per Capacity Day decreased 16.7% versus 2025 on an as reported basis and decreased 17.1% on a Constant Currency basis. Net Yield decreased 6.5% on an as reported basis and 6.7% on a Constant Currency basis, ~220 basis points better than guidance of an 8.9% decline. Gross Cruise Cost per Capacity Day was approximately $301, compared to $302 in the prior year. Adjusted Net Cruise Cost excluding Fuel per Capacity Day was approximately $152 on an as reported basis and on a Constant Currency basis. Compared to 2025, this metric was down 2.2% on an as reported basis and decreased 2.3% on a Constant Currency basis, ~140 basis points better than guidance of down 0.9%.Adjusted EBITDA was $937 million, exceeding guidance of $874 million by $63 million. Adjusted EPS was $1.12, exceeding guidance of $0.90 by $0.22.2026 Full Year Outlook Reflecting its stronger-than-expected third quarter performance, the Company is raising its full year 2026 guidance. A summary of the updated full year guidance is provided below: 2026 full year Net Yield on a Constant Currency basis is expected to be down approximately 4.4% versus 2025.2026 Adjusted Net Cruise Cost excluding Fuel per Capacity Day is expected to be down approximately 0.4% on a Constant Currency basis versus 2025, reflecting better-than-previously-guided performance driven by ongoing savings.2026 full year Adjusted EBITDA is expected to be approximately $2.55 billion. Adjusted Operational EBITDA Margin for the full year 2026 is expected to be 33.7%.Full year Adjusted Net Income is expected to be approximately $789 million. Adjusted EPS is expected to be approximately $1.70.Q4 2026 OutlookQ4 2026 Net Yield on a Constant Currency basis remains unchanged from prior guidance, declining ~6.5%. The outlook reflects a modestly improved underlying Net Yield performance, offset by an unfavorable mix impact due to the delayed delivery of Seven Seas Prestige to late December and the cancellation of select voyages on Seven Seas Voyager transiting the Suez Canal.Q4 2026 Adjusted Net Cruise Cost excluding fuel per Capacity Day is expected to be up 1.7% on a Constant Currency basis versus 2025.Q4 2026 Adjusted EBITDA is expected to be $414 million and Adjusted Operational EBITDA margin for the quarter is expected to be 25.0%.Booking Environment Update The Company’s booked position for the next 12 months has improved modestly since the last earnings release but remains below its optimal range. The expanded offering at Great Stirrup Cay, including the recently opened Great Tides Waterpark, together with the upcoming rollout of a new marketing platform and improvements to revenue management capabilities, including the implementation of the base-loading strategy across 2027 and 2028 sailings, is expected to support stronger demand and a healthier booking curve over time. Looking ahead to 2027, the Company’s pricing for the first half is ahead of levels at the same time last year, while its booked position remains below the comparable prior-year position. For the second half, pricing is ahead with the booked position in line with the same time last year. These trends, together with the expected benefits of the Company’s commercial initiatives, support the Company’s expectation for full year Net Yield growth of 1% to 2%, with a meaningful acceleration in the second half. Liquidity and Financial Position The Company is committed to optimizing its balance sheet and reducing Net Leverage. As of September 30, 2026, the Company had total debt of $15.1 billion and Net Debt of $14.8 billion. Net Leverage ended the quarter at 5.5x. On a pro forma basis, considering the recent debt issuance and upsizing of the Revolving Loan Facility, liquidity as of September 30, 2026 would have been $2.1 billion, including approximately $257 million of cash and cash equivalents and $1.8 billion of availability under the Revolving Loan Facility. "Subsequent to quarter-end, we completed the issuance of $950 million of 8.750% senior notes due 2031 and upsized our Revolving Loan Facility, strengthening our liquidity position. With no significant debt maturities until 2029, we believe our existing financial resources and ongoing cash generation provide a clear path to fund our turnaround strategy and strengthen our balance sheet over time,” said Mark A. Kempa, Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer of Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings Ltd. "Reducing Net Leverage remains a top priority. We continue to center our focus on cost discipline and cash generation as we work to restore Net Yield growth, with stronger earnings and cash flow expected to drive further deleveraging.” Outlook and Guidance In addition to announcing the results for the third quarter of 2026, the Company also provided guidance for the fourth quarter and full year 2026, along with accompanying sensitivities, subject to changes in the broad macroeconomic environment. Terminology Adjusted EBITDA. EBITDA adjusted for other income (expense), net and other supplemental adjustments. Adjusted EPS. Adjusted Net Income divided by the number of diluted weighted-average shares outstanding. Adjusted Gross Margin. Gross margin adjusted for payroll and related, fuel, food, other and ship depreciation inclusive of any loss on disposal of ships. Gross margin is calculated pursuant to GAAP as total revenue less total cruise operating expense and ship depreciation inclusive of any loss on disposal of ships. Adjusted Net Cruise Cost Excluding Fuel. Net Cruise Cost Excluding Fuel adjusted for supplemental adjustments. Adjusted Net Income. Net income (loss), adjusted for the effect of dilutive securities and other supplemental adjustments. Adjusted Operational EBITDA Margin. Adjusted EBITDA divided by Adjusted Gross Margin. Adjusted ROIC. An amount expressed as a percentage equal to (i) Adjusted EBITDA less depreciation and amortization plus other supplemental adjustments, divided by (ii) the sum of total long-term debt, including the short-term portion thereof, and shareholders’ equity as of the end of a respective quarter, averaged for the most recent five fiscal quarters ending with the last date of the applicable fiscal year. Berths. Double occupancy capacity per cabin (single occupancy per studio cabin) even though many cabins can accommodate three or more passengers. Capacity Days. Berths available for sale multiplied by the number of cruise days for the period for ships in service excluding announced ships with long-term charters to third parties once their charters begin. Constant Currency. A calculation whereby foreign currency-denominated revenues and expenses in a period are converted at the U.S. dollar exchange rate of a comparable period in order to eliminate the effects of foreign exchange fluctuations. Dry-dock. A process whereby a ship is positioned in a large basin where all of the fresh/sea water is pumped out in order to carry out cleaning and repairs of those parts of a ship which are below the water line. EBITDA. Earnings before interest, taxes, and depreciation and amortization. EPS. Earnings (loss) per share. GAAP. Generally accepted accounting principles in the U.S. Gross Cruise Cost. Gross Cruise Cost less commissions, transportation and other expense and onboard and other expense. Net Cruise Cost Excluding Fuel. Net Cruise Cost less fuel expense. Net Debt. Long-term debt, including current portion, less cash and cash equivalents. Net Leverage. Net Debt divided by Adjusted EBITDA for the trailing twelve-months. Net Per Diem. Adjusted Gross Margin divided by Passenger Cruise Days. Net Yield. Adjusted Gross Margin per Capacity Day. Occupancy, Occupancy Percentage or Load Factor. articles.title: Zacatecas Silver Receives Drill Permit and Finalizes Maiden Drill Program at Oso Negro, Sonora
articles.description: VANCOUVER, British Columbia, Oct. 29, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Zacatecas Silver Corp. (TSXV: ZAC | OTCQB: ZCTSF | FRA: 7TV) ("Zacatecas Silver” or the "Company”) is pleased to announce that it has received the drill permit for its Oso Negro gold-silver project ("Oso Negro” or the "Project”) in Sonora, Mexico, and has finalized a 2,500 metre maiden diamond drill program at the Prospecto and Tere vein systems. Surface access has been secured from the private landowner and the Project is drill-ready. Highlights Drill permit received from SEMARNAT for the Oso Negro concession, completing the final regulatory requirement ahead of drilling. Surface access secured from the private landowner. Oso Negro is situated entirely on private land. A 2,500 metre maiden diamond drill program has been finalized across the Prospecto and Tere low sulphidation epithermal vein systems, to be collared from 20 drill pads. Pads are designed to allow multiple holes to be drilled from each location, thereby minimizing pad construction and rig move costs. The drill program comprises a number of shallow angled holes designed to intersect the vein between 40 to 80 vertical metres below rock chip outcrop samples that returned high gold and silver grades. The level of exposure in the low sulphidation epithermal system at Oso Negro significantly reduces drill targeting risk by allowing a large number of shallow holes to be drilled for the planned 2,500 metres. Phase One and Phase Two rock chip sampling returned assays up to 20.3 g/t gold and 3,480 g/t silver from 510 samples across more than 3 kilometres of mapped vein strike. Drill Program The maiden drill program comprises approximately 2,500 metres of shallow angled diamond drilling collared from 20 pad locations across the Prospecto and Tere vein systems. Pads have been designed to allow multiple holes to be drilled from each location, thereby minimizing pad construction and rig move costs and reducing surface disturbance. The holes are designed to intersect the vein between 40 to 80 vertical metres below rock chip outcrop samples that returned high gold and silver grades. Testing the veins immediately beneath known high-grade surface mineralization addresses the first question a maiden program at Oso Negro needs to answer, being whether grades at surface are maintained at depth. The level of exposure in the low sulphidation epithermal system at Oso Negro significantly reduces drill targeting risk. The veins outcrop along their mapped strike, so collar positions and orientations have been set from mineralization that has been mapped and sampled directly rather than inferred indirectly. Because the targets are shallow, the planned 2,500 metres allows a large number of holes to be drilled across both vein systems rather than a small number of deeper tests. Vein textures logged during mapping are typical of the upper levels of a low sulphidation epithermal system. In systems of this type the highest precious metal grades are commonly developed within a boiling zone at depth, which at Oso Negro remains untested. Figure 1: Oso Negro concession showing mapped veins, planned drill holes and rock chip gold results (g/t Au) at the Prospecto and Tere vein systems. Figure 2: Oso Negro concession showing mapped veins, planned drill holes and rock chip silver results (g/t Ag) at the Prospecto and Tere vein systems. Planned drill hole traces are preliminary and remain subject to final program design and ground conditions. Rock chip samples are selective by nature and may not be representative of the grade of the mineralization. Sampled widths are not true widths. Permitting and Surface Access The drill permit has been granted for the Oso Negro concession, allowing the Company to proceed with pad construction and drilling. Ecological studies over the Project area were completed earlier in 2026 as a prerequisite to the permit application. Oso Negro is situated entirely on privately held ground. The Company entered into a surface access agreement with the landowner on August 28, 2026 for an initial term of one year, renewable, covering the planned drill program. Project Overview Oso Negro is an undrilled low sulphidation epithermal gold-silver vein system located in the northern Sonora epithermal belt. Geological mapping and surface sampling completed across two programs in 2026 extended the system to more than 3 kilometres of mapped vein strike across the Prospecto and Tere structures. Veins are up to 3 metres wide and multiphase, with common breccias and pervasive iron oxides after sulphides. Phase One rock chip sampling, reported June 9, 2026, returned assays up to 14.8 g/t gold and 2,340 g/t silver from 156 samples. Phase Two results, reported September 10, 2026, returned assays up to 20.3 g/t gold and 3,480 g/t silver from a further 354 samples, bringing the program total to 510 samples. Of the Phase Two samples, 63 returned between 1 and 20.3 g/t gold and 58 returned between 100 and 3,480 g/t silver. The Prospecto vein and its southeast splays are gold and silver mineralized along their full 600 metre mapped strike. CEO Quote "Oso Negro is ready to drill,” said Eric Vanderleeuw, Chief Executive Officer and Director. "We now have the permit, we have access agreed with the landowner, and the holes are designed. What makes this program different is how much of the system is exposed at surface. We are collaring holes beneath veins we have mapped and sampled at grades up to 20.3 g/t gold and 3,480 g/t silver, and we only need to go 40 to 80 metres beneath those samples to test them. Shallow targets and multi-hole pads mean 2,500 metres buys us a lot of holes across the vein systems rather than a handful of deep ones. This is the first drilling ever completed on the property, and behind it we have a growing portfolio with Lourdes, and two mineral resources at Panuco and Esperanza. That combination, a resource base that holds value and a pipeline of advancing targets, is what we have been building toward. The recent sampling results at Cumaro exceeded our expectations and gave us a second compelling drill target. The permit application for Cumaro is in, and we look forward to drilling it alongside Oso Negro.” Quality Assurance and Quality Control Rock chip sampling referred to in this news release was supervised by Company personnel. Samples were cut for reference, photographed, bagged and shipped to ALS in Zacatecas, where they were dried, sieved and pulverized, and analyzed for gold, silver and base metals by multi-element ICP following four-acid digestion. Certified reference materials, blanks and field duplicates were inserted into the sample stream. Rock chip samples are selective by nature and may not be representative of the grade of the mineralization. Surface sampling results are not indicative of results that may be obtained from drilling. Qualified Person The technical information in this news release has been reviewed and approved by Chris Wilson, B.Sc. (Hons), PhD, FAusIMM (CP), FSEG, FGS, Chief Geologist of Zacatecas Silver. Dr. Wilson is a Qualified Person as defined by NI 43-101 and is not independent due being Chief Geologist and a director. About Zacatecas Silver Corp. Zacatecas Silver is a multi-asset precious metals exploration company with a portfolio of seven projects across Mexico, spanning Zacatecas, Sonora, Morelos, and Oaxaca, and has recently entered into an option to acquire the Lourdes project in Guanajuato. The Zacatecas Silver Project is located in Zacatecas State, within the highly prospective Fresnillo silver belt, which has produced over 6.2 billion ounces of silver. The Company holds 7,826 hectares of ground prospective for low-sulphidation and intermediate-sulphidation silver-base metal mineralization. A Mineral Resource Estimate at the Panuco deposit comprises 3.41 million tonnes at 187 g/t AgEq for 20.5 million ounces AgEq (see news release dated May 31, 2023). The property is 25 km southeast of MAG Silver's Juanicipio Mine and Fresnillo PLC's Fresnillo Mine, and shares boundaries with Defiance Silver and Endeavour Silver. Esperanza is an advanced stage, attractive low-cost, low-capital-intensity and low-technical-risk growth project located in Morelos state, Mexico. The Company announced a Mineral Resource Estimate at Esperanza consisting of a Measured and Indicated Mineral Resource Estimate of 45.4 million tonnes at 0.79 g/t AuEq (0.76 g/t gold and 8.5 g/t silver) for 1.15 million ounces AuEq (1.11 million ounces gold and 12.37 million ounces silver) and an Inferred Mineral Resource Estimate of 11.2 million tonnes at 0.57 g/t AuEq (0.53 g/t gold and 11.2 g/t silver) for 208 thousand ounces AuEq (190 thousand ounces gold and 4.02 million ounces silver) (see news release dated June 22, 2026). The Company also holds four exploration properties in Sonora and Oaxaca. Oso Negro (Sonora) is an undrilled, high-grade low sulphidation epithermal system with multiple veins mapped over more than 3 km of strike length. Cumaro (Sonora) is situated along trend from Coeur Mining’s El Picacho development and hosts extensions of proven low sulphidation vein systems with high-grade channel sampling results. La Lola (Sonora) is a large, underexplored 1,183-hectare property anchored by the La Barra vein, a 5 km structure reaching up to 40 m in width. Ejutla (Oaxaca) comprises 10,603 hectares in the Taviche-Miahuatlán region near the former Fortuna Silver San José Mine, hosting multiple vein systems and alteration zones anomalous in gold, silver, and Carlin-style pathfinder elements. The Company has also entered into an option to acquire a 100% interest in Lourdes (Guanajuato), a 509-hectare low sulphidation epithermal gold-silver vein system with limited historical drilling. articles.title: Sensex Jumps 905 Points, Nifty Closes Above 22,900
articles.description: Indian benchmark indices ended Thursday's session with strong gains, recovering from the previous day's decline. The BSE Sensex jumped 905.01 points, or 1.24%, to close at 74,151.04, while the Nifty 50 rose 237.90 points, or 1.05%, to settle at 22,936.75. Buying across major sectors lifted sentiment, with the Nifty Realty index leading the rally. The US Federal Reserve's decision to hold interest rates unchanged also remained in focus. Realty and FMCG Lead Sectoral Gains The Nifty Realty index emerged as the top-performing sector, rising 2.75%, followed by the Nifty FMCG index, which gained 2.34%. Banking stocks also witnessed buying interest, with Kotak Mahindra Bank advancing 4.32%. IT stocks recovered from Wednesday's losses, while the Nifty Auto index was the only sectoral loser, declining 0.24%. The broader market participated in the rally, with the mid-cap and small-cap indices gaining approximately 0.99% and 0.95%, respectively. Federal Reserve Holds Rates; Crude Oil Above $114 The US Federal Reserve maintained its benchmark interest rate at 3.75% to 4%, keeping investors focused on its outlook for inflation and future monetary policy. Meanwhile, Brent crude prices declined approximately 1.4% to around $114 per barrel. Despite the decline, elevated oil prices continued to pose inflation and import-cost risks for India. Nifty 50: Key Index Contributors Kotak Mahindra Bank contributed the most to the Nifty's gains, adding 30.64 points. Adani Ports and Eternal followed with contributions of 18.94 and 18.84 points, respectively. On the downside, HDFC Bank dragged the index by 6.71 points, followed by Maruti Suzuki at 4.36 points and Trent at 3.81 points. Market Breadth Remains Positive Market breadth favoured buyers, with 2,196 stocks advancing against 1,387 declines among 3,693 traded stocks. Another 110 stocks remained unchanged. During the session, 54 stocks touched their 52-week highs, while 117 slipped to 52-week lows. Additionally, 140 stocks hit upper circuits compared with 69 stocks hitting lower circuits. European Markets Trade Higher European equities traded higher on Thursday, led by France's CAC 40, which gained 0.97% to 7,963.48. Germany's DAX rose 0.90% to 25,936.06, while the UK's FTSE 100 advanced 0.32% to 10,728.70. All three indices remained in positive territory as European trading continued. US Stock Futures Show Mixed Trend US stock index futures traded mixed, with Dow Jones futures rising 304 points, or 0.58%, to 53,000. In contrast, S&P 500 futures declined 15 points, or 0.19%, to 7,768.25, while Nasdaq 100 futures dropped 276.50 points, or 0.92%, to 29,703, indicating weakness in technology-heavy futures.

articles.title: Mike Alfred joins Opendoor Board of Directors
articles.description: SAN FRANCISCO, Oct. 29, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Opendoor Technologies Inc. ("Opendoor”) (Nasdaq: OPEN), the e-commerce platform for residential real estate, today announced that Mike Alfred, Founder and Managing Partner of Alpine Fox LP, has been appointed to its Board of Directors ("Board”), effective immediately. Mr. Alfred will also serve on the Nominating and Corporate Governance Committee of the Board. "I’m excited to welcome Mike to our Board,” said Kaz Nejatian, Opendoor CEO, President and Board Director. "Mike is a builder who has founded and scaled technology companies, and he’s spent years as an investor thinking about how companies create long-term value. His perspective as an operator, investor and public company director will be incredibly valuable as we continue to make buying and selling a home simple and certain.” "I’m honored to join Opendoor’s Board,” said Mr. Alfred. "Opendoor is tackling one of the largest and most important markets in the world. I look forward to working with Kaz, the Board and the management team to help build on the company’s momentum.” Mr. Alfred is the Founder and Managing Partner of Alpine Fox LP, a private investment partnership and a shareholder of Opendoor. He has served on the board of directors of IREN Limited (Nasdaq: IREN), an AI data center developer and Bitcoin miner, since 2021, and of Bakkt Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: BKKT) since 2025. Previously, Mr. Alfred co-founded and served as Chief Executive Officer of Digital Assets Data, Inc., a financial technology and data company serving the digital asset ecosystem, until its sale to New York Digital Investment Group in 2020. Before that, he co-founded and served as Chief Executive Officer of BrightScope, Inc., a financial information company, from 2008 until its acquisition by Strategic Insight, Inc. in 2016. He then served as a Managing Director and member of Strategic Insight’s executive committee. Mr. Alfred also advises the Chief Executive Officer of Amenify Corporation, a real estate technology company, and serves on the boards of the privately held companies Eaglebrook Advisors and Wealthie Inc. He holds a B.A. in History from Stanford University. About Opendoor Opendoor exists to tilt the world in favor of homeowners by making homeownership simpler, faster, and fairer for everyone. Since 2014, Opendoor has given people a more convenient, more certain way to buy and sell a home, whether they already own or are working hard to become homeowners. Opendoor currently operates in markets across the U.S. For more information, please visit www.opendoor.com. Contacts Investors: investors@opendoor.com Media: Contact Kaz on X @Nejatian

articles.title: Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results
articles.description: MIAMI, Oct. 29, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings Ltd. (NYSE: NCLH) (together with NCL Corporation Ltd. ("NCLC”), "Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings”, "Norwegian”, "NCLH” or the "Company”) today reported financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026 and provided guidance for the fourth quarter and full year 2026. Highlights Third quarter total revenue was $2.9 billion. GAAP net income was $491 million with EPS of $1.07. Delivered third quarter results above guidance, with Adjusted EBITDA1 of $937 million, Adjusted Net Income of $514 million and Adjusted EPS of $1.12. Raised full year 2026 guidance, with 2026 Adjusted EBITDA now expected to be approximately $2.55 billion and Adjusted EPS of approximately $1.70. Opened Great Tides Waterpark in early September at the Company’s private island, Great Stirrup Cay. Spanning nearly six acres, the waterpark expands the island’s offerings with attractions for guests of all ages. Announced additional run-rate savings of ~$100 million related to guest and crew air optimization and other tactical changes in promotional offerings that will phase in through 2028. Completed the issuance of $950 million of senior notes due 2031 on October 15, which together with the upsizing of the Revolving Loan Facility, enhanced the Company’s liquidity position. Completed the sale of Oceania Sirena and entered into a charter agreement to continue operating the vessel through spring 2028. Entered into a memorandum of agreement to sell Oceania Insignia with an expected delivery to the buyer in September 2027. "We delivered third quarter results that came in above guidance, all while continuing to strengthen our commercial capabilities, improve operating efficiency and enhance the guest experience,” said John W. Chidsey, Chairperson and Chief Executive Officer of Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings Ltd. "As we implement the next phase of our turnaround, we are focused on sharpening Norwegian Cruise Line’s brand positioning, improving marketing effectiveness and taking a more disciplined approach to revenue management as well as a prudent base-loading strategy. We are seeing the early signs of progress and expect Net Yield growth of 1% to 2% in 2027, with a meaningful acceleration in the back half of the year.” ____________________ 1 See "Terminology”, "Non-GAAP Financial Measures” and "Outlook and Guidance” below for additional information about Adjusted EPS, Adjusted EBITDA, Adjusted Net Income, Net Leverage and other non-GAAP financial measures. Third Quarter 2026 Highlights The Company delivered third quarter results above guidance, driven primarily by stronger-than-expected close-in demand and onboard spend. Continued cost discipline also contributed to lower-than-expected unit costs, further supporting the quarter’s profitability. Generated total revenue of $2.9 billion. GAAP net income was $491 million compared to $419 million in the prior year, with EPS of $1.07. Gross margin per Capacity Day decreased 16.7% versus 2025 on an as reported basis and decreased 17.1% on a Constant Currency basis. Net Yield decreased 6.5% on an as reported basis and 6.7% on a Constant Currency basis, ~220 basis points better than guidance of an 8.9% decline. Gross Cruise Cost per Capacity Day was approximately $301, compared to $302 in the prior year. Adjusted Net Cruise Cost excluding Fuel per Capacity Day was approximately $152 on an as reported basis and on a Constant Currency basis. Compared to 2025, this metric was down 2.2% on an as reported basis and decreased 2.3% on a Constant Currency basis, ~140 basis points better than guidance of down 0.9%.Adjusted EBITDA was $937 million, exceeding guidance of $874 million by $63 million. Adjusted EPS was $1.12, exceeding guidance of $0.90 by $0.22.2026 Full Year Outlook Reflecting its stronger-than-expected third quarter performance, the Company is raising its full year 2026 guidance. A summary of the updated full year guidance is provided below: 2026 full year Net Yield on a Constant Currency basis is expected to be down approximately 4.4% versus 2025.2026 Adjusted Net Cruise Cost excluding Fuel per Capacity Day is expected to be down approximately 0.4% on a Constant Currency basis versus 2025, reflecting better-than-previously-guided performance driven by ongoing savings.2026 full year Adjusted EBITDA is expected to be approximately $2.55 billion. Adjusted Operational EBITDA Margin for the full year 2026 is expected to be 33.7%.Full year Adjusted Net Income is expected to be approximately $789 million. Terminology Adjusted EBITDA. EBITDA adjusted for other income (expense), net and other supplemental adjustments. Adjusted EPS. Adjusted Net Income divided by the number of diluted weighted-average shares outstanding. Adjusted Gross Margin. Gross margin adjusted for payroll and related, fuel, food, other and ship depreciation inclusive of any loss on disposal of ships. Gross margin is calculated pursuant to GAAP as total revenue less total cruise operating expense and ship depreciation inclusive of any loss on disposal of ships. Adjusted Net Cruise Cost Excluding Fuel. Net Cruise Cost Excluding Fuel adjusted for supplemental adjustments. Adjusted Net Income. Net income (loss), adjusted for the effect of dilutive securities and other supplemental adjustments. Adjusted Operational EBITDA Margin. Adjusted EBITDA divided by Adjusted Gross Margin. Adjusted ROIC. An amount expressed as a percentage equal to (i) Adjusted EBITDA less depreciation and amortization plus other supplemental adjustments, divided by (ii) the sum of total long-term debt, including the short-term portion thereof, and shareholders’ equity as of the end of a respective quarter, averaged for the most recent five fiscal quarters ending with the last date of the applicable fiscal year. Berths. Double occupancy capacity per cabin (single occupancy per studio cabin) even though many cabins can accommodate three or more passengers. Capacity Days. Berths available for sale multiplied by the number of cruise days for the period for ships in service excluding announced ships with long-term charters to third parties once their charters begin. Constant Currency. A calculation whereby foreign currency-denominated revenues and expenses in a period are converted at the U.S. dollar exchange rate of a comparable period in order to eliminate the effects of foreign exchange fluctuations. Dry-dock. A process whereby a ship is positioned in a large basin where all of the fresh/sea water is pumped out in order to carry out cleaning and repairs of those parts of a ship which are below the water line. EBITDA. Earnings before interest, taxes, and depreciation and amortization. EPS. Earnings (loss) per share. GAAP. Generally accepted accounting principles in the U.S. Gross Cruise Cost. The sum of total cruise operating expense and marketing, general and administrative expense. Net Cruise Cost. Gross Cruise Cost less commissions, transportation and other expense and onboard and other expense. Net Cruise Cost Excluding Fuel. Net Cruise Cost less fuel expense. Net Debt. Long-term debt, including current portion, less cash and cash equivalents. Net Leverage. Net Debt divided by Adjusted EBITDA for the trailing twelve-months. Net Per Diem. Adjusted Gross Margin divided by Passenger Cruise Days. Net Yield. Adjusted Gross Margin per Capacity Day. Occupancy, Occupancy Percentage or Load Factor. The ratio of Passenger Cruise Days to Capacity Days. A percentage greater than 100% indicates that three or more passengers occupied some cabins. Passenger Cruise Days. The number of passengers carried for the period, multiplied by the number of days in their respective cruises excluding ships with long-term charters to third parties. Revolving Loan Facility. An unfunded defined benefit pension plan for certain crew members which computes benefits based on years of service, subject to certain requirements. 2030 Exchangeable Notes. articles.description: CEO Dr Martin Edlund: "With highly competitive technology performance, two flagship projects advancing towards commercialisation and growing international business opportunities, we have a strong foundation for the next steps." GOTHENBURG, Sweden, Oct. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Significant events July-September In August, Minesto announced that the Dragon 4 power plant, upgraded with a new power-take-off (PTO) system that improves energy production throughout the tidal flow cycle, has delivered record breaking electricity generation over the summer in Vestmannasund, Faroe Islands. The upgraded PTO system successfully demonstrated improved energy production throughout all tidal flow cycles while simultaneously reducing system costs. The company implemented organisational changes to enhance the commercial readiness of its service offering. Site installation and operations (installation and handling) are managed through customer delivery projects, such as the Vestmanna Site Project, relying on Minesto's proprietary and proven methods and technology, but primarily delivered by external and local resources to enhance flexibility and efficiency. Technology development related to Operations methods and tools is integrated into Product Development led by Chief Technology Officer, Bernt Erik Westre. The Faroe Islands Space Program, the global communication campaign featuring the unique Minesto Dragons, was awarded the Grand Prix at the Cannes Lions International Festival of Creativity 2026, recognising it as the world's most outstanding B2B creative campaign of the year. To date, the campaign has generated more than 800 million impressions, bringing significant global exposure to Minesto's Dragon technology. After the end of the period Minesto was selected by the European Commission to enter Grant Agreement Preparation (GAP) for funding of EUR 20.2 million under the EU Innovation Fund. The selected project, Euro Dragon Farm, is a first-of-its-kind 10 MW tidal kite array planned for deployment in Ireland. Minesto now enters the GAP phase to finalise and sign the grant agreement with the European Climate, Infrastructure and Environment Executive Agency (CINEA). The process is expected to be finalised in the first quarter of 2027. The Board of Directors announced its intention to carry out a rights issue of approximately SEK 130 million. The rights issue is covered by subscription undertakings and a guarantee commitment of approximately SEK 78 million, corresponding to approximately 60 percent of the issue. The proceeds are intended to secure project investments for the first commercial Dragon Farms, with Hestfjord in the Faroe Islands and Euro Dragon Farm in Ireland as the lead candidates, as well as support microgrid sales, technology development and working capital. Minesto validated its industry-leading service turnaround capability as the upgraded Dragon 4 tidal power plant returned to operation in only 48 hours following its latest service intervention. The achievement demonstrates a unique service concept that delivers high availability and low operating costs, supporting the competitiveness of Minesto's Dragon technology. Minesto was selected to participate in the Sweden-Indonesia Sustainability Partnership (SISP), a Swedish government-backed initiative supporting sustainable development and business collaboration in Indonesia. Through the partnership, Minesto will work closely with Business Sweden to advance tidal energy opportunities in one of the world's most promising markets for ocean energy, supporting Indonesia's transition towards a sustainable energy system. Minesto signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) with Morteza Capital, an investment manager and project developer with a strong regional network. The collaboration aims to develop commercial opportunities for tidal energy in the Maldives, where Minesto's unique Dragon technology has the potential to support the country's challenging energy transition while preserving its unique natural environment. Minesto signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) with Chilean project developer Trayen Power to collaborate on the development of tidal and ocean current energy projects in Chile. Chile represents a particularly attractive market for Minesto, combining world-class tidal and ocean current resources with opportunities for both large utility-scale arrays and microgrid applications. The report is available to download at Minesto's website: Minesto | Investor information CEO comment: "Proven progress, growing opportunities The global energy transition is creating growing demand for reliable and predictable renewable electricity. As the share of wind and solar power increases, complementary energy sources become increasingly important to ensure balanced, resilient and cost-efficient energy systems. This is where Minesto's unique tidal technology can deliver significant value. The value of competitive tidal energy extends beyond predictable electricity generation. Our own Power System Analysis proves that integrating tidal energy can reduce the need for excess generation capacity, limit renewable energy curtailment and improve the balance between electricity supply and demand. This creates value for the entire energy system, beyond the cost of electricity produced by an individual power plant. This insight has now reached key stakeholders in most of the world's major tidal energy markets. At the same time, the tidal energy industry is undergoing consolidation. The transition from technology development to commercial deployment has proven challenging, even for developers backed by major industrial players. Minesto continues to make progress by expanding our commercial partnerships, generating electricity, accumulating operational experience and systematically improving our technology. Put simply, the need for tidal energy is growing and the recognition of its value is increasing, while the number of companies capable of delivering it is shrinking. Our claim of tidal industry leadership is not just a bold statement; it is a fact. Continued technology progress and new performance levels During the third quarter, we continued to advance the performance and operational capabilities of our Dragon technology. Years of systematic testing, evaluation and continuous improvement have delivered significant progress, with the upgraded Dragon 4 representing the latest major step forward. Ongoing testing has demonstrated new levels of power production, confirming the positive impact of the upgrades and the potential for further performance improvements. Equally important is our progress in operational efficiency and serviceability, both critical to achieving high availability and competitive electricity generation costs. Dragon 4 also provides an efficient platform for developing and validating improvements that can be transferred to the larger Dragon 12 system. Our growing body of operational evidence and experience from real ocean conditions strengthens the foundation for commercial-scale deployment. Technology progress driving commercial opportunities Our systematic technology development, continuous performance improvements and accumulated operational data are strengthening confidence in Minesto's technology among potential partners and investors. This progress is increasingly translating into commercial opportunities, as demonstrated by our recent collaboration agreements in Chile and the Maldives, as well as our selection for the Sweden-Indonesia Sustainability Partnership. Alongside our larger Dragon Farm projects, we are pursuing opportunities for smaller reference installations, particularly in markets where tidal energy can complement existing microgrid systems. These installations offer an attractive route to market, creating commercial value while establishing local operating references and opportunities for subsequent expansion. articles.description: Indian benchmark indices ended Thursday's session with strong gains, recovering from the previous day's decline. The BSE Sensex jumped 905.01 points, or 1.24%, to close at 74,151.04, while the Nifty 50 rose 237.90 points, or 1.05%, to settle at 22,936.75. Buying across major sectors lifted sentiment, with the Nifty Realty index leading the rally. The US Federal Reserve's decision to hold interest rates unchanged also remained in focus. Realty and FMCG Lead Sectoral Gains The Nifty Realty index emerged as the top-performing sector, rising 2.75%, followed by the Nifty FMCG index, which gained 2.34%. Banking stocks also witnessed buying interest, with Kotak Mahindra Bank advancing 4.32%. IT stocks recovered from Wednesday's losses, while the Nifty Auto index was the only sectoral loser, declining 0.24%. The broader market participated in the rally, with the mid-cap and small-cap indices gaining approximately 0.99% and 0.95%, respectively. Federal Reserve Holds Rates; Crude Oil Above $114 The US Federal Reserve maintained its benchmark interest rate at 3.75% to 4%, keeping investors focused on its outlook for inflation and future monetary policy. Meanwhile, Brent crude prices declined approximately 1.4% to around $114 per barrel. Despite the decline, elevated oil prices continued to pose inflation and import-cost risks for India. Nifty 50: Key Index Contributors Kotak Mahindra Bank contributed the most to the Nifty's gains, adding 30.64 points. Adani Ports and Eternal followed with contributions of 18.94 and 18.84 points, respectively. On the downside, HDFC Bank dragged the index by 6.71 points, followed by Maruti Suzuki at 4.36 points and Trent at 3.81 points. Market Breadth Remains Positive Market breadth favoured buyers, with 2,196 stocks advancing against 1,387 declines among 3,693 traded stocks. Another 110 stocks remained unchanged. During the session, 54 stocks touched their 52-week highs, while 117 slipped to 52-week lows. Additionally, 140 stocks hit upper circuits compared with 69 stocks hitting lower circuits. articles.description: VANCOUVER, British Columbia, Oct. 29, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Miata Metals Corp. (TSXV: MMET; FSE: 8NQ; OTCQX: MMETF) ("Miata” or the "Company”) is pleased to announce drill results from four holes from its ongoing 25,000 m diamond drilling program at its Sela Creek Gold Project ("Sela Creek” or the "Project”) in Suriname. Hole 26DDH-JT-026 delivered an exceptionally high-grade intercept of 13.59 m at 10.33 g/t Au from 184.41 m, including 3.56 m at 37.62 g/t Au. This result represents a step-out from recently reported hole 26DDH-JT-025, which intersected 43.0 m at 2.42 g/t Au and a separate 25.6 m at 1.96 g/t Au, further supporting the continuity of mineralization through central Jons Trend. JT-026 also intersected a separate 21.0 m at 1.01 g/t Au from 207.0 m, including 6.95 m at 1.45 g/t Au, providing further evidence for multiple stacked mineralized zones at Jons Trend. The additional 21.0 m mineralized interval below the headline intersect further demonstrates the stacked nature of the gold-bearing vein system at Jons Trend. "JT-026 is another exceptional result from central Jons Trend and, importantly, provides further evidence for continuity of the higher-grade mineralization at depth,” stated Dr. Jacob (Jaap) Verbaas, CEO of Miata Metals. "The interval of 13.59 m at 10.33 g/t Au, including 3.56 metres at 37.62 grams per tonne gold, is one of Miata’s highest-grade intervals reported to date. The additional 21-metre mineralized interval below the headline zone also reinforces the stacked nature of the system. Together with the two broad intervals recently reported from JT-025, we continue to see an encouraging combination of grade, width and continuity through the central portion of Jons Trend. Our ongoing drilling is focused on extending these mineralized zones along their interpreted plunge and at depth.” Figure 1. The hole represents a step-out from recently reported JT-025, further supporting the continuity of mineralization through central Jons Trend. The principal interval in JT-026 returned 13.59 m at 10.33 g/t Au from 184.41 m, including 3.56 m at 37.62 g/t Au from 184.41 m. The results from JT-026 build on the recently reported intersections in JT-025, providing further evidence of continuity within the mineralized system at central Jons Trend. The high-grade interval in JT-026 also demonstrates the presence of higher-grade mineralization within the broader stacked vein system. Mineralization within the JT-026 high-grade interval is associated with strong silicification and a silica-sulfide breccia within the southwest-dipping vein array. Visible gold has also been observed within the mineralized interval. Figure 2. Core photographs from the JT-026 high-grade interval showing silica-sulfide brecciation, quartz veining and visible gold. A. 26DDH-JT-026 at 185.27 m (6.36 g/t Au) showing quartz-pyrite (py)-chlorite vein cross-cutting silica and biotite altered schist. B. 26DDH-JT-026 at 185.69 m (4.56 g/t Au) showing quartz-pyrite extensional veining and brecciation, with thin fractures filled with visible gold (Au) cross-cutting veins. Below the headline intersection, JT-026 returned a separate interval of 21.0 m at 1.01 g/t Au from 207.0 m, including 6.95 m at 1.45 g/t Au from 219.0 m. The presence of multiple mineralized intervals at different depths is consistent with the stacked-vein architecture observed throughout central Jons Trend. The results from JT-026 further extend the mineralization identified in recently reported hole JT-025, which returned two broad zones of 25.6 m at 1.96 g/t Au and 43.0 m at 2.42 g/t Au. articles.title: Zacatecas Silver Receives Drill Permit and Finalizes Maiden Drill Program at Oso Negro, Sonora
articles.description: VANCOUVER, British Columbia, Oct. 29, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Zacatecas Silver Corp. (TSXV: ZAC | OTCQB: ZCTSF | FRA: 7TV) ("Zacatecas Silver” or the "Company”) is pleased to announce that it has received the drill permit for its Oso Negro gold-silver project ("Oso Negro” or the "Project”) in Sonora, Mexico, and has finalized a 2,500 metre maiden diamond drill program at the Prospecto and Tere vein systems. Surface access has been secured from the private landowner and the Project is drill-ready. Highlights Drill permit received from SEMARNAT for the Oso Negro concession, completing the final regulatory requirement ahead of drilling. Surface access secured from the private landowner. Oso Negro is situated entirely on private land. A 2,500 metre maiden diamond drill program has been finalized across the Prospecto and Tere low sulphidation epithermal vein systems, to be collared from 20 drill pads. Pads are designed to allow multiple holes to be drilled from each location, thereby minimizing pad construction and rig move costs. The drill program comprises a number of shallow angled holes designed to intersect the vein between 40 to 80 vertical metres below rock chip outcrop samples that returned high gold and silver grades. The level of exposure in the low sulphidation epithermal system at Oso Negro significantly reduces drill targeting risk by allowing a large number of shallow holes to be drilled for the planned 2,500 metres. Phase One and Phase Two rock chip sampling returned assays up to 20.3 g/t gold and 3,480 g/t silver from 510 samples across more than 3 kilometres of mapped vein strike. Drill Program The maiden drill program comprises approximately 2,500 metres of shallow angled diamond drilling collared from 20 pad locations across the Prospecto and Tere vein systems. Pads have been designed to allow multiple holes to be drilled from each location, thereby minimizing pad construction and rig move costs and reducing surface disturbance. The holes are designed to intersect the vein between 40 to 80 vertical metres below rock chip outcrop samples that returned high gold and silver grades. Testing the veins immediately beneath known high-grade surface mineralization addresses the first question a maiden program at Oso Negro needs to answer, being whether grades at surface are maintained at depth. The level of exposure in the low sulphidation epithermal system at Oso Negro significantly reduces drill targeting risk. The veins outcrop along their mapped strike, so collar positions and orientations have been set from mineralization that has been mapped and sampled directly rather than inferred indirectly. Because the targets are shallow, the planned 2,500 metres allows a large number of holes to be drilled across both vein systems rather than a small number of deeper tests. Vein textures logged during mapping are typical of the upper levels of a low sulphidation epithermal system. In systems of this type the highest precious metal grades are commonly developed within a boiling zone at depth, which at Oso Negro remains untested. Figure 1: Oso Negro concession showing mapped veins, planned drill holes and rock chip gold results (g/t Au) at the Prospecto and Tere vein systems. Figure 2: Oso Negro concession showing mapped veins, planned drill holes and rock chip silver results (g/t Ag) at the Prospecto and Tere vein systems. Planned drill hole traces are preliminary and remain subject to final program design and ground conditions. Rock chip samples are selective by nature and may not be representative of the grade of the mineralization. Sampled widths are not true widths. Permitting and Surface Access The drill permit has been granted for the Oso Negro concession, allowing the Company to proceed with pad construction and drilling. Ecological studies over the Project area were completed earlier in 2026 as a prerequisite to the permit application. Oso Negro is situated entirely on privately held ground. The Company entered into a surface access agreement with the landowner on August 28, 2026 for an initial term of one year, renewable, covering the planned drill program. Project Overview Oso Negro is an undrilled low sulphidation epithermal gold-silver vein system located in the northern Sonora epithermal belt. Geological mapping and surface sampling completed across two programs in 2026 extended the system to more than 3 kilometres of mapped vein strike across the Prospecto and Tere structures. Veins are up to 3 metres wide and multiphase, with common breccias and pervasive iron oxides after sulphides. Phase One rock chip sampling, reported June 9, 2026, returned assays up to 14.8 g/t gold and 2,340 g/t silver from 156 samples. Phase Two results, reported September 10, 2026, returned assays up to 20.3 g/t gold and 3,480 g/t silver from a further 354 samples, bringing the program total to 510 samples. Of the Phase Two samples, 63 returned between 1 and 20.3 g/t gold and 58 returned between 100 and 3,480 g/t silver. The Prospecto vein and its southeast splays are gold and silver mineralized along their full 600 metre mapped strike. CEO Quote "Oso Negro is ready to drill,” said Eric Vanderleeuw, Chief Executive Officer and Director. "We now have the permit, we have access agreed with the landowner, and the holes are designed. What makes this program different is how much of the system is exposed at surface. We are collaring holes beneath veins we have mapped and sampled at grades up to 20.3 g/t gold and 3,480 g/t silver, and we only need to go 40 to 80 metres beneath those samples to test them. Shallow targets and multi-hole pads mean 2,500 metres buys us a lot of holes across the vein systems rather than a handful of deep ones. This is the first drilling ever completed on the property, and behind it we have a growing portfolio with Lourdes, and two mineral resources at Panuco and Esperanza. That combination, a resource base that holds value and a pipeline of advancing targets, is what we have been building toward. The recent sampling results at Cumaro exceeded our expectations and gave us a second compelling drill target. The permit application for Cumaro is in, and we look forward to drilling it alongside Oso Negro.” Quality Assurance and Quality Control Rock chip sampling referred to in this news release was supervised by Company personnel. Samples were cut for reference, photographed, bagged and shipped to ALS in Zacatecas, where they were dried, sieved and pulverized, and analyzed for gold, silver and base metals by multi-element ICP following four-acid digestion. Certified reference materials, blanks and field duplicates were inserted into the sample stream. Rock chip samples are selective by nature and may not be representative of the grade of the mineralization. Surface sampling results are not indicative of results that may be obtained from drilling. Qualified Person The technical information in this news release has been reviewed and approved by Chris Wilson, B.Sc. (Hons), PhD, FAusIMM (CP), FSEG, FGS, Chief Geologist of Zacatecas Silver. Dr. Wilson is a Qualified Person as defined by NI 43-101 and is not independent due being Chief Geologist and a director. About Zacatecas Silver Corp. Zacatecas Silver is a multi-asset precious metals exploration company with a portfolio of seven projects across Mexico, spanning Zacatecas, Sonora, Morelos, and Oaxaca, and has recently entered into an option to acquire the Lourdes project in Guanajuato. The Zacatecas Silver Project is located in Zacatecas State, within the highly prospective Fresnillo silver belt, which has produced over 6.2 billion ounces of silver. The Company holds 7,826 hectares of ground prospective for low-sulphidation and intermediate-sulphidation silver-base metal mineralization. A Mineral Resource Estimate at the Panuco deposit comprises 3.41 million tonnes at 187 g/t AgEq for 20.5 million ounces AgEq (see news release dated May 31, 2023). The property is 25 km southeast of MAG Silver's Juanicipio Mine and Fresnillo PLC's Fresnillo Mine, and shares boundaries with Defiance Silver and Endeavour Silver. Esperanza is an advanced stage, attractive low-cost, low-capital-intensity and low-technical-risk growth project located in Morelos state, Mexico. The Company announced a Mineral Resource Estimate at Esperanza consisting of a Measured and Indicated Mineral Resource Estimate of 45.4 million tonnes at 0.79 g/t AuEq (0.76 g/t gold and 8.5 g/t silver) for 1.15 million ounces AuEq (1.11 million ounces gold and 12.37 million ounces silver) and an Inferred Mineral Resource Estimate of 11.2 million tonnes at 0.57 g/t AuEq (0.53 g/t gold and 11.2 g/t silver) for 208 thousand ounces AuEq (190 thousand ounces gold and 4.02 million ounces silver) (see news release dated June 22, 2026). The Company also holds four exploration properties in Sonora and Oaxaca. Oso Negro (Sonora) is an undrilled, high-grade low sulphidation epithermal system with multiple veins mapped over more than 3 km of strike length. Cumaro (Sonora) is situated along trend from Coeur Mining’s El Picacho development and hosts extensions of proven low sulphidation vein systems with high-grade channel sampling results. La Lola (Sonora) is a large, underexplored 1,183-hectare property anchored by the La Barra vein, a 5 km structure reaching up to 40 m in width. Ejutla (Oaxaca) comprises 10,603 hectares in the Taviche-Miahuatlán region near the former Fortuna Silver San José Mine, hosting multiple vein systems and alteration zones anomalous in gold, silver, and Carlin-style pathfinder elements. The Company has also entered into an option to acquire a 100% interest in Lourdes (Guanajuato), a 509-hectare low sulphidation epithermal gold-silver vein system with limited historical drilling.
